descriptor_source_findings: Four per-peak numerical descriptors: following and preceding absolute-amplitude ratios, signed opposite-peak offset, and normalized sawtooth mean squared error.
Opposite-peak offset subtracts nominal small-window radius even when the window is clipped; retain or explicitly review this boundary behavior.
Sawtooth comparison asserts aligned maximum position; invalid peaks cannot silently continue.
Source clips descriptor windows to a fixed signal length. Generalized input length requires an explicit independent contract and comparison at source dimensions.
Measurement processing groups three signals, derives fundamental Fourier phase and assigns right-closed phase quadrants; exact zero phase is excluded by the source bin convention.

descriptors.independent_choice: Clip windows to actual input length; preserve nominal radius offset and missing-neighbor NaNs.

aggregation_source_findings: Full source path filters peaks jointly exceeding following-neighbor ratio 0.33333 and amplitude 50.
Three counts use all retained peaks and alternating phase-quadrant pairs.

Six additional aggregates use the first alternating quadrant pair: amplitude mean and sample standard deviation, both neighbor ratio means, absolute opposite-extremum offset mean, and sawtooth MSE mean.
Left-joined absent groups remain NaN rather than zero counts. Sample standard deviation is NaN for singleton groups. NaN neighbor ratios are skipped by group means.
The source feature called sawtooth RMSE actually contains mean squared error without a square root.

independent_choices: FFT fundamental summation order with one cycle per supplied signal.
Input-length generalization; missing quadrant represented internally as minus one.

training_source_findings: Repeated class-specific random assignment into five folds using legacy NumPy seeded draws; assignments are not balanced stratified K-fold partitions.
Each rotation trains on three folds, reserves the current fold for validation and next fold for nominal test; both held-out sets participate in early stopping.
Source prediction accumulation uses global training objects rather than function arguments; independent implementation must explicitly align populations.
MCC threshold search evaluates greater-than-or-equal predictions at distinct probabilities before moving their labels; equal best scores choose the later threshold.
Source held-out threshold evaluation uses strict greater-than, differing at equality from its threshold optimizer. Preserve this distinction explicitly.
Training function alone does not establish the final inference threshold or final model configuration; inspect invocation and inference cells next.

training.label_policy: Any positive signal makes measurement positive; final threshold fits original per-signal labels against repeated in-training measurement predictions.
